name: ai-engineering-from-scratch
description: Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.
one_liner: A free, structured curriculum that teaches you how to build real AI systems (not just call an API) step by step, from first principles to shipping.
buyer: A career-switcher or junior developer trying to break into AI engineering roles who doesn't know what to actually build to prove they can do the job.
business_use_cases: A bootcamp or online course creator uses it as free top-of-funnel content, then upsells a paid mentorship or job-placement track.
A hiring manager links candidates to specific modules as a take-home screening exercise instead of writing one from scratch.
A content creator turns each module into a YouTube/newsletter series and monetizes via sponsorships once it has an audience.

money_ideas.idea: Paid cohort-based course or mentorship layered on top of the free curriculum.
Sponsorships/affiliate links (compute credits, tools) placed alongside the free lessons.

steal_this: Repackage it into a 30-day email drip course this weekend and use it as a lead magnet for a paid AI-engineering coaching offer.
